When [[Androl Genhald]] was trying to prevent [[Logain]] from being [[Turning|Turned]], [[Mazrim Taim]] shot a blast of [[balefire]] at him. Androl had trouble making a [[Gateway]] because of the [[dreamspike]], but because of his [[Talent]] he was able to create one the size of a coin. Taim's balefire went through the Gateway and Androl escaped unharmed.{{ref/book|14|14}}

[[Image:Web-icon.svg|right|150px]]
We are never told where Androl sent Taim's balefire.{{ref|That's a fan-fic just waiting to happen.}} My question is: What if Androl had opened the other end of the gateway only a short distance away so that the balefire hit Taim himself? The balefire would erase Taim backwards in time, so that some of his actions never happened…including shooting the balefire! And if he never shot the balefire in the first place, then he can't be destroyed by it!

To complicate matters, somethings that are erased by balefire still "count" as having happened. [[Mat]] is killed by [[Rahvin]] in [[Caemlyn]]{{ref/book|5|54}} but his death is undone when Rand kills Rahvin with balefire.{{ref/book|5|55}} We later find out that not only did this fulfill an [[Aelfinn]] prophecy of Mat dying and living again{{ref/book|4|15}}, but it also severed his connection to the [[Horn of Valere]].{{ref/book|14|39}}

So would Taim cease to exist or wouldn't he? If he survived, what would everyone have seen? Would there be any other side effects?

It's no wonder that balefire unravels the [[Pattern]]. It's paradoxical!
